depiction.primary_object: speech bubble outline formed as a looping arrow
modifiers: clockwise arrowhead at top of outline
depiction.composition: single hybrid symbol combining a chat bubble with a circular repeat arrow

ambiguity: At small sizes it can look like a plain refresh/reload arrow or an ordinary speech bubble if the tail or arrowhead is missed.

modifier_semantics.modifier: clockwise arrowhead integrated into bubble stroke
modifier_semantics.meaning: repeat, cycle back, follow up, or continuous loop of communication

task_intents: request feedback from colleagues or clients
ping someone again for an update

reasoning: The icon merges a speech bubble with a circular reload/repeat arrow, clearly signaling a communication loop: following up, replying again, or giving/requesting feedback. Follow-ups and feedback requests are among the most common real-world to-do items across work, admin, and personal life. It could occasionally be misread at tiny sizes as a generic refresh arrow or plain chat bubble.
